doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

chapter: Organ work, singers and Russia tour
title: Living in Florida; New York versus the West Coast
summary: He now lives in Florida and sees himself fundamentally as a New York musician.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Interesting. You live in Florida now?
Do you notice a difference, I assume you’ve worked on both coasts, and do you still like working in New York City or the west coast, or is it by choice that you’re not in those areas anymore?

Well I’ve never been really a west coast musician although I have done some film work there and occasional appearances. I’m still a New York musician fundamentally. I really couldn’t make a comparison, and wouldn’t do that question justice.
